facts.text: The product is titled “Sofa Drip - 3 Seater Sofa (Fabric, Pine Green).”
The product page displays the selection as Pine Green / 3 Seater.
The listed material is “100 % Polyester Fabric.”
It is upholstered in performance-woven fabric and built on a solid wood frame.
It has deep seats, plush removable back cushions, and supportive high-density foam.
The sofa has a floating-arm design.
Its elevated legs make cleaning under the sofa easier.
The listed dimensions are 90 cm × 178 cm × 85.5 cm (35.4″ × 70.7″ × 33.7″).
